$comment: A 74LS86 with gate 1 on (A, B), gate 2 on (B, A), gate 3 on (A, GND) and gate 4 on (B, VCC), where A and B come from pulse sources.
B is high from 2.5 to 7.5 ms and from 17.5 to 22.5 ms (5 ms pulses, 15 ms period); A is high from 8.5 ms on. Every edge takes 1 us. The four input combinations in time order:
By hand, from the XOR function table (Y = A xor B): gates 1 and 2 read 0, 1, 0, 1, 0 (equal inputs give 0); gate 3 (A xor GND) follows A: 0, 0, 0, 1, 1; gate 4 (B xor VCC) is NOT B: 1, 0, 1, 1, 0.

The harness samples at 0, 5, 10 and 20 ms: 00, 01, 10 and 11, one of each. test/core/promoted-kinds-fixtures.test.ts reads all four combinations on both engines (an output reads HIGH above 2.4 V and LOW below 0.5 V).
